pattern: scripts/lib/module-graph.mjs (and everything built on it -- docs/MODULE-MAP.md, test/deadExports.test.ts's reachability gate) only sees static `import ... from "..."` clauses; a file reached only via a dynamic `await import(...)` reads as unreachable/demo-only/dead when it is actually live, so any dead-code or reachability finding from this tool can be silently wrong wherever a dynamic import exists.
